body:
We’re strengthening the Frontier Safety Framework (FSF) to help identify and mitigate severe risks from advanced AI models.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [Google DeepMind News](https://deepmind.google/blog/strengthening-our-frontier-safety-framework/).
